newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli aircraft attack targets in south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli aircraft attack targets in south Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli aircraft attacked guerrilla targets in south Lebanon on Sunday hours after two members of an Israeli-backed militia were killed in bomb explosions, the army said.
"Warplanes attacked terrorist targets in the Jizzine area this afternoon. Pilots reported accurate hits and all planes returned safely to base," a military announcement said.

Pro-Israeli militia sources in south Lebanon said a captain in the South Lebanon Army militia was killed by a bomb planted in his car and another SLA militiaman died when a roadside bomb exploded as he rushed to the scene of the earlier attack.
Both attacks occured in Jizzine, a strip of territory officially outside Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone but under SLA control.
In Beirut, the pro-Iranian Hizbollah claimed responsibility for both bomb attacks.
Hizbollah guerrillas regularly attack Israeli troops and their local militia allies in a bid to oust them from the 15-km (nine miles)-wide occupation zone.
